scope: Source inspection identifies remaining finite adapters; the area-bound replay also preserves an executable retained circular-fragment integral limitation. None of these observations establishes full behavior coverage or repair.

observations: Rounded/chamfered pad ratios and their products are still binary64 before the native primitive boundary; tiny source dimensions/radii need a complete exact parser path.
Malformed optional rect_delta and ratio tokens still use parser defaults. Native primitive rejection alone cannot validate lost source information.

Footprint/pad placement computes a finite geometry location separately from its native marker. Missing/unrepresentable ParsedPoint2 data may select a zero default; exact scalar source parsing remains incomplete at these call sites.
Circle diameter halving and oval endpoint/body construction still use finite arithmetic.
The chamfer_ratio branch returns before roundrect_rratio is read; combined chamfer/rounding source intent still needs a dedicated parser audit.
Line normalization computes a finite squared length before constructing corners; invalid/degenerate inputs use Option and caller filter_map paths still require an uncertainty audit.
Arc and Bezier stroke helpers still turn finite samples into authoritative line polygons.

Retained non-materialized circular algebraic fragments are routed to line-only area/native lowering and may lack a native integral. The original CPArti features 1723/1724 retain an unavailable overlap integral in area-bound/before.json and after.json; the exact bounding-box cap independently decides their non-duplication. General integration and lossless circular lowering remain open.
